description: Temporary Discord server template designed to organize a single content creation project from planning to completion.

channels.name: 📢-announcements
channels.topic: Important announcements and updates about the video project.

channels.name: 📅-schedule
channels.topic: Recording schedules, meetings, deadlines, and important times.

channels.name: 🔗-resources
channels.topic: Links, references, files, and other resources needed for the video.

channels.name: 💬-chat
channels.topic: General conversation between everyone involved in the video.

channels.name: 💡-suggestions
channels.topic: Share ideas and suggestions that could improve the video.

channels.name: 📸-clips
channels.topic: Share clips, screenshots, previews, and interesting moments from the project.

channels.name: 📋-organization
channels.topic: Internal organization, tasks, and coordination for the video.

channels.name: 🔐-private
channels.topic: Private staff discussions and sensitive project information.
